company_size: HarborCart is a fictional online retailer with 120 employees and two warehouses. The organization has a regional operations team and separate business owners for customer services, logistics and data management. COMPANY_END_SENTINEL
departments: Customer support, development, finance and warehouse operations.
infrastructure_summary: A public e-commerce web application and customer REST APIs handle account login, order tracking and refunds against a private SQL database.
network_architecture: Third-party logistics vendors use VPN access to warehouse networks. Vendor access reviews are infrequent.
data_storage:
Customer addresses and order histories are stored in SQL. Images and backups use cloud object storage. Backup restoration tests are not documented. Payment processing is outsourced; no full card numbers are stored.
